title: Highly reproducible human brain organoids recapitulate cerebral cortex cellular diversity.
protocol: Reconstitute 5 mg of Y-27632 in 2.96 mL of sterile water to make a 5 mM stock solution.
Store the Y-27632 stock at -20 °C for up to 1 year, avoiding multiple freeze-thaw cycles.
Reconstitute 10 mg of SB431542 in 2.6 mL of DMSO to make a 10 mM stock solution.
Store the SB431542 stock at -20 °C for up to 1 year, avoiding multiple freeze-thaw cycles.
Reconstitute 10 mg of IWR1 in 814 μL of DMSO to make a 30 mM stock solution.
Store the IWR1 stock at -20 °C for up to 1 year, avoiding multiple freeze-thaw cycles.
Calculate the required milligrams of heparin by dividing the number of units of the batch by the potency in units per mg from the certificate of analysis.
Reconstitute the calculated amount of heparin in water to make a 10 mg/mL stock solution.
Sterilize the reconstituted heparin solution through a 0.22 μm filter if it is not already sterile.
Store the filtered or unfiltered heparin solution at 2-8°C for up to 2 years.

Prepare Cortical Differentiation Medium I by mixing 77 mL G-MEM, 20 mL KnockOut Serum Replacement, 1 mL MEM Non-Essential Amino Acids Solution, 1 mL sodium pyruvate, and 182 μL of 55 mM 2-mercaptoethanol.
Add 1 mL Penicillin/Streptomycin Solution to the mixture for Cortical Differentiation Medium I.
Prepare Cortical Differentiation Medium II by mixing 96 mL DMEM/F-12, 1 mL GlutaMAX Supplement, and 1 mL N-2 Supplement.
Add 1 mL Chemically Defined Lipid Concentrate and 100 μL of 250 μg/ml Fungizone to the mixture for Cortical Differentiation Medium II.
Include 1 mL Penicillin/Streptomycin Solution in the final step for preparing Cortical Differentiation Medium II.
Prepare Cortical Differentiation Medium III by mixing 170 mL DMEM/F-12, 20 mL Hyclone Fetal Bovine Serum, and 2 mL Chemically Defined Lipid Concentrate.
Add 2 mL GlutaMAX Supplement and 2 mL N-2 Supplement to the mixture for Cortical Differentiation Medium III.
Include 100 μL of 10 mg/mL heparin in the mixture for Cortical Differentiation Medium III.
Add 200 μL of 250 μg/ml Fungizone and 2 mL Penicillin/Streptomycin Solution to the mixture for Cortical Differentiation Medium III.
Include 2 mL Matrigel in the final step for preparing Cortical Differentiation Medium III.

Maintain feeder-free hPSCs on TC-treated cell culture dishes pre-coated with Geltrex, in mTESR1 medium with 100 U/mL penicillin and 100 μg/mL streptomycin, in a humidified incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Start with hPSCs that are 80-90% confluent.
Prepare the seeding medium by mixing CDM I (10 mL), ROCK inhibitor (40 μL of 5 mM stock - final 20 μM), IWR1 (1 μL of 30 mM stock - 3 μM), and SB 431542 (5 μL of 10 mM stock – final 5 μM).
Wash the cells with PBS.
Add Accutase to the dish and incubate for approximately 4-5 minutes at 37°C.
Use a 1 mL pipette to dissociate the cells.
Add mTESR1 to dilute the Accutase suspension containing the dissociated cells and transfer content to a 15 mL conical tube.
Centrifuge the cells.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the cells in CDM I.
Centrifuge the cells.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the cells in 1 ml of CDM I.
Count the cells.
Dilute the proper volume of cell suspension (containing 900,000 cells) into 10 mL of Seeding Medium.
Plate 9,000 cells/well in a Prime surface 96V plate (100 μl/well).
Keep the plate in a humidified tissue culture incubator at 37 °C and 5% CO2.
Observe the aggregates under the microscope.
Prepare CDM I media mix by combining 10 mL of CDM I, 40 μL of ROCK inhibitor (final concentration 20 μM), 1 μL of IWR1 (final concentration 3 μM), and 5 μL of SB 431542 (final concentration 5 μM).
Using a multichannel pipette, add 100 μl of the prepared mix to each well.
Return the plate to a humidified tissue culture incubator at 37°C and 5% CO₂.
Prepare CDM I by mixing:
- 10 mL of CDM I
- 1 μL of IWR1 (30 mM stock, final concentration 3 μM)
- 5 μL of SB 431542 (10 mM stock, final concentration 5 μM)
Remove 80 μL of medium from each well of the multiwell plate.
Add 100 μL of the prepared mix to each well.
Return the plate to a humidified tissue culture incubator at 37 °C and 5% CO2.
Repeat media change procedure using CDM I on Day 9, Day 12, and Day 15.
Add CDM II to low ultra-low attachment 100 mm plates.
Transfer aggregates to the 100 mm plate using a 200 μL pipette.
Maintain the plate on a CO2-resistant orbital shaker at 70 rpm inside a humidified tissue culture incubator at 37 °C and 5% CO2.
Aspirate medium from each plate carefully without disturbing the aggregates.
Replace the aspirated medium with CDM II.
Return the plate to the orbital shaker at 70 rpm in a humidified tissue culture incubator set at 37 °C and 5% CO2.
Repeat procedure as on Day 21 for media change using CDM II Media on Day 24.
Repeat procedure as on Day 21 for media change using CDM II Media on Day 27.
Repeat procedure as on Day 21 for media change using CDM II Media on Day 30.
Repeat procedure as on Day 21 for media change using CDM II Media on Day 33.
Unpack a spinner flask in a sterile environment.
Fill the spinner flask with 100 mL of fresh CDM III Media.
Transfer the aggregates to the spinner flask.
Maintain cultures on a magnetic stirrer at 56 rpm inside a humidified tissue culture incubator at 37 °C and 5% CO2.
Verify that organoids contain dorsal forebrain cell types via immunohistochemistry (IHC).
Replace the medium by completely aspirating it and adding fresh CDM III.
Remove the cap from one of the arms of the spinner flask to insert the 1 mL aspirating pipette; avoid removing the main top cap of the spinner flask.
Return spinner flasks to a magnetic stirrer at 56 rpm inside a humidified tissue culture incubator at 37 °C and 5% CO2.
Repeat procedure as in Day 42 for media change with CDM III on Days 49, 56, and 63.
Change the medium using fresh CDM IV on Day 70 and onwards.
Reconstitute Papain vial with 5 mL of Earle’s medium.
Reconstitute DNase vial with 500 μL of Earle’s medium.
Reconstitute Inhibitor vial with 32 mL of Earle’s medium.
Mix 500 μL of reconstituted DNase with 5 mL of reconstituted Papain gently.
Transfer each organoid to an individual 60 mm dish carefully.
Aspirate excess media from the 60 mm dish.
Add 2.5 mL of Papain + DNase solution to the 60 mm dish containing the organoids.
Mince organoids into small pieces less than 1 mm using a new, sterile razor blade.
Transfer the plate to an orbital shaker at 70 rpm inside a humidified tissue culture incubator at 37 °C and 5% CO₂ for 30 minutes.
Use a 1 mL pipette to gently dissociate and break up minced pieces.
Return the plate to the orbital shaker using the same conditions as Step 6 for 10 more minutes.
Add 5 mL of Earle’s medium plus 3 mL of reconstituted Inhibitor solution to a 15 mL conical tube (prepare 1 tube per organoid).
Using a 10 mL pipette, gently pipette the minced pieces up-and-down 10 times.
Transfer the entire volume to an empty 15 mL conical tube and wait for the debris to settle (1-3 minutes).
Transfer the cell suspension (avoiding debris) to the tube prepared in Step 9.
Invert the tube a few times to mix.
Centrifuge the cells at 300g for 7 minutes.
Aspirate the supernatant, and gently resuspend the cells in 500-1,000 μL of 1x PBS.
Filter the resuspended cells.
Dilute and count the cells.
Resuspend the cells at 1,000 cells/μL.
Add BSA to a final concentration of 0.04%.
